payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over needed people count: dp[i] = min cost for i people using unbounded units of n-people (main round) or 1-person (additional round).
payload.rationale: 1D DP array with state i representing remaining persons. Transitions: add d (one additional round) or c + dp[i-n] (one main round). Classic unbounded knapsack style, but essentially 1D state DP.
